# HAPI v0.25.1.2

Compared with the previous maintained release, this build rebases the maintenance line onto upstream main through 5eae68d2, including merged PR #1201 for concise terminal-card labels and the current upstream session, machine, and Cursor fixes.

Compared with the official release, it carries selected maintained fixes (PRs #869, #912, #955, #997, #1009, #906, #1029, #1113, #1094, #1087, #958, #1188, and #1189), PR #1225 for Hub SQLite storage usage, plus fork release, cache, signing, and collaboration safeguards.
